name: demo-playwright-c-sharp
summary: A small C# walkthrough demo that uses Playwright to launch Chrome, navigate to testingexamples.github.io, and demonstrate locator strategies and form interactions.
description: Demonstration of Playwright browser automation using C#, navigating to https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/ and demonstrating locating elements by id, name, class, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting an option in a select element.
